generations.text:
**Research idea:** Test whether a degradation-mode-aware, condition-normalized EIS representation improves battery SOH estimation when temperature, SOC, and aging trajectory differ from training conditions. The proposed estimator would account for temperature/SOC effects on interpretable impedance features, retain mode-sensitive information where identifiable, and predict capacity-based SOH with calibrated uncertainty.

**Hypothesis:** It will yield lower out-of-condition error and better uncertainty calibration than both raw-feature and condition-corrected aggregate-feature baselines, especially when distinct aging modes cause similar capacity loss. The key scientific test is whether mode-sensitive impedance features add predictive value beyond condition compensation alone.

The idea and its source limitations are saved in [idea.md](/idea.md). The reusable lesson is saved in [ideation-memory.md](/memory/ideation-memory.md). The idea is grounded only in the supplied abstracts; novelty, mode identifiability, and performance remain unverified. No experiments were implemented.
